pages.text: $(l)OPPM$() downloads and updates programs from the OpenPrograms collection. Craft the OPPM floppy from a $(item)Floppy Disk$() and an $(item)Interweb$(), and put an $(item)Internet Card$() in the computer.

Run $(l)install$() and choose the OPPM disk to install it permanently.$(li)$(l)oppm list$() - every package$(li)$(l)oppm list <word>$() - search$(li)$(l)oppm info <pkg>$() - details$(li)$(l)oppm install <pkg>$()$(li)$(l)oppm update all$()
Most programs in this book install this way. Try $(l)oppm install mynaptic$() for a graphical package browser.
Browse every OPPM package online, with descriptions and authors.
